r19.exp: 'Every generation thinks the weather isn't what it used to be. (19)____. The year 2010 brought a winter that belongs to the record books.' → D: BUT THIS TIME, THERE SEEM TO BE NUMEROUS EXAMPLES INDICATING THAT THINGS REALLY MAY BE CHANGING.

r20.exp: 'New York City shut down by worst blizzard. (20)____.' → G: AND THAT WAS ONLY ONE OF MANY REPORTED INSTANCES OF FREAKISH WEATHER TAKING THEIR TOLL ACROSS CONTINENTS IN THAT YEAR.

r21.exp: 'For some, weather was pure JOY. (21)____. At least 1500 people DIED.' → B: FOR OTHERS, THE EXTREMES OF GLOBAL CLIMATE WERE ANNOYING, EXPENSIVE OR EVEN TRAGIC.

r22.exp: 'Extreme weather can be result of global warming, a consequence of POLLUTION. (22)____.' → A: IT SENDS WARM GREENHOUSE GASSES ABOVE OCEANS INTO THE UPPER COLDER LAYER OF ATMOSPHERE TURNING THEM INTO SNOW.

r23.exp: 'Not yet established connection. (23)____. It involves summers hotter and drier... winters colder and wetter.' → E: HOWEVER, IT SHOWS THAT IN MOST PARTS OF THE WORLD, THERE IS A SPECIFIC PATTERN THAT SEEMS TO BE EMERGING.

r24.exp: 'If summer gets too hot, result is TINDERY PLAINS AND FORESTS. (24)____.' → C: THIS IN TURN CAUSES FIRES THAT BURN OUT OF CONTROL OVER THOUSANDS OF ACRES CREATING EXTENSIVE DAMAGE AND CASUALTIES.

r25.exp: 'The time in which a dropout COULD earn a decent wage has ended' — 'could' za prošlu mogućnost koja više ne postoji.

r26.exp: 'Find a GOOD JOB' — 'job' = određeno radno mjesto; 'career' bi se koristilo s drugačijim kontekstom.

r27.exp: 'WHAT IS MORE, each dropout is responsible for financial costs' — priložni veznik za dodavanje: what is more = štoviše, uz to.

r28.exp: 'Graduation RATES' — fiksna kolokacija: graduation rates = stope završavanja škole.

r29.exp: 'The EXTENT of the crisis has been revealed' — 'extent' = razmjer, opseg (koliko je nešto veliko/ozbiljno).

r30.exp: 'The public knew LITTLE of the gravity of the problem' — 'little' uz nebrojive imenice (gravity = nešto nebrojivo).

r31.exp: 'Low attendance and failing grades, WHICH can identify future dropouts' — nerestiktivna relativna rečenica s 'which'.

r32.exp: 'Can be as MUCH as 40 to 50 percent' — 'as much as' za nebrojive veličine (postotke, količine).

r33.exp: 'Ended UP interrupting' — frazalni glagol: end up + gerund = završiti radeći nešto nenamjeravano.

r34.exp: 'As frustrating AS this habit is' — komparativna/koncesivna konstrukcija: as + adjective + as = koliko god.

r35.exp: 'Trying to understand WHY most of us interrupt others' — upitna zamjenica 'why' u neupravnom pitanju.

r36.exp: 'The argument is not WORTH listening to' — fiksna konstrukcija: not worth + gerund = nije vrijedno.

r37.exp: 'The urge to GET to the point' — fiksni izraz: get to the point = doći do suštine/reći što se želi.

r38.exp: 'We LOSE self-control' — fiksna kolokacija: lose self-control = izgubiti kontrolu nad sobom.

r39.exp: 'Easier in a face-to-face conversation THAN when on the telephone' — komparativni veznik 'than' za usporedbu.

r40.exp: 'THERE are times that I still find myself unable to resist' — egzistencijalni 'there': there are = postoje.
